configuration.attention: softmax(log(token_prior) + dot(Wq[schema_pair], Wk[token])/sqrt(64)) over tokens only
configuration.attention_work: Forward: schema query B*Q*C once, token keys B*T*L, token logits B*T*Q*C*L; step repeats schema projection
configuration.belief_feature: own probability and entropy divided by log(valid candidate count)
configuration.normalization: log_b -= logsumexp(log_b) before features/transition and after each real update
configuration.observation_mode_binding: Caller authenticates raw contextual tokens and chunk-weighted priors

observation_paths.tokens: [B,T,L,D]; shared raw tokens, candidate-specific pooled evidence

configuration.old_fit_scope: parameter loading possible, but not corrected training or empirical efficacy evidence
configuration.padding: exact original state values; no normalization committed on padded turns
configuration.parameter_schema: same as DialogueCopyMemory for the same method and dimensions
configuration.pooling: L2-normalize weighted raw token sum, eps=1e-12; zero vector remains zero
configuration.representation_control: Same normalized head; two added bias-free projections; no encoder calls
configuration.scope: conditional stochastic transition; not calibrated Bayes or architecture novelty
configuration.token_prior: Positive on token_mask, zero elsewhere; real-turn sum within 2e-6 of one

updates.candidate_gru: shared per-candidate GRU then candidate softmax
updates.readout: softmax(write logits); no learned state feedback

evaluation.scope: Includes assembly, monitored forward, extraction and saved prediction I/O; encoder excluded

head: scalar
observation_work_scope: Cumulative emitted/gathered tensor payload, not peak memory or measured storage I/O/cache misses
process_memory_scope: Process lifetime RSS high-water sampled at receipt; not a per-fit allocation or unique working set
